summary: Israeli artillery shelling continues across multiple southern Lebanese locations including Zoutar ash-Sharqiyah, Wadi Zabqin, and Al-Qantara/Wadi al-Hajir, with reports of property destruction in Hula and flare deployment over Al-Bayyada. Iranian air defense systems engaged over Silvaneh while UAV activity was detected near Sardasht and Urmia in West Azerbaijan Province, indicating heightened airspace monitoring. IRGC Navy claims U.S. forces withdrew hundreds of kilometers from the Strait of Hormuz, though CENTCOM asserts continued presence and vigilance with regional partners.

points: Iranian air defense systems activated over Silvaneh in West Azerbaijan Province at 22:25 local time, while UAV activity was detected over Sardasht near the Iraqi border at 22:32 and over Urmia at 22:38, suggesting heightened surveillance or response posture in the northwest. (Source: @shin_persian/11612)

IRGC Navy claimed U.S. forces moved hundreds of kilometers away from the Strait of Hormuz; U.S. CENTCOM countered that forces remain present and vigilant, controlling the strait with regional partners, indicating competing narratives over Gulf naval posture. (Source: @shin_persian/11604)

Russia's Rosatom state nuclear corporation will increase its staffing at Iran's Bushehr nuclear power plant to 700 personnel, per Interfax, signaling deepening Russian-Iranian nuclear cooperation amid regional tensions. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8941)

Two UH-60 Black Hawk transport helicopters were tracked moving toward northern Israel (described as northern occupied Palestine), indicating possible troop or equipment movement in the Galilee sector. (Source: @redlinkleb/50201)

An Egyptian national crossed the border fence into Israel overnight near Nitzana, was spotted by surveillance cameras, and apprehended by dispatched troops; the IDF views the incident gravely and maintains heightened alert in the area during election day. (Source: @manniefabian/59437)

Voter turnout among IDF soldiers reached 68% by 5 p.m., up from 65% at the same hour in 2022, with 850 polling stations deployed across military bases domestically and beyond Israel's borders. (Source: @manniefabian/59441)
Israeli artillery shelling targeted Zoutar ash-Sharqiyah in southern Lebanon, with live map tracking indicating ongoing fire missions in the area. (Source: @redlinkleb/50217)
Additional artillery strikes hit Wadi Zabqin in southern Lebanon, per live map monitoring of fire missions. (Source: @redlinkleb/50220)
Artillery shelling also struck Al-Qantara and Wadi al-Hajir in southern Lebanon, expanding the geographic scope of Israeli fire. (Source: @redlinkleb/50233)

Israeli forces burned homes in the town of Hula, and dropped a flare bomb over Al-Bayyada, indicating combined kinetic and illumination operations in the border sector. (Source: @redlinkleb/50196, @redlinkleb/50218)
Fire sweeping operations were conducted in Zoutar ash-Sharqiyah, suggesting systematic targeting of positions in the area. (Source: @redlinkleb/50173)

UAV activity detected over Sardasht in West Azerbaijan Province near the Iraqi border at 22:32 local time, suggesting cross-border aerial monitoring or operations involving Iraqi airspace. (Source: @shin_persian/11612)

An Airbus A320 (registration HZ-A3) landed at Tehran's Mehrabad Airport arriving from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia at 17:12 local time, indicating continued civilian air connectivity between the two capitals. (Source: @shin_persian/11608)

key_developments: Israeli artillery conducts sustained shelling across at least four southern Lebanese locations — Zoutar ash-Sharqiyah, Wadi Zabqin, Al-Qantara, and Wadi al-Hajir — with concurrent fire sweeping and property destruction in Hula. (Source: @redlinkleb/50217)

Iranian air defense engages over Silvaneh while UAVs operate near Sardasht (Iraqi border) and Urmia in West Azerbaijan Province, signaling elevated air defense readiness in northwest Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11612)

IRGC Navy asserts U.S. forces withdrew hundreds of kilometers from Strait of Hormuz; CENTCOM denies withdrawal, confirming continued presence and control with regional partners. (Source: @shin_persian/11604)
Egyptian national illegally crosses border near Nitzana, apprehended by IDF; military maintains heightened alert in sector during national election day. (Source: @manniefabian/59437)

Rosatom to expand Bushehr nuclear plant staffing to 700 Russian personnel, deepening Moscow-Tehran nuclear cooperation amid regional instability. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8941)

Israeli election exit polls show no bloc securing 61-seat majority; voter turnout highest since 1973, with IDF soldier participation at 68% by 5 p.m. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8944, @manniefabian/59441)
sections.threat_assessment: Israeli artillery operations in southern Lebanon have expanded to at least four distinct locations with combined kinetic and illumination tactics, indicating sustained pressure on border areas. Iranian air defense activation and UAV activity in West Azerbaijan Province suggest Tehran is monitoring northern airspace closely, possibly in response to Israeli or U.S. aerial movements. The competing IRGC and CENTCOM narratives over Strait of Hormuz posture reflect ongoing strategic signaling, while Rosatom's Bushehr expansion underscores long-term Russian-Iranian defense-industrial ties. The Egyptian border breach, though isolated, demonstrates persistent infiltration risk along the Sinai frontier during periods of domestic distraction.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese monitoring channels (Red Alert Lebanon) are actively tracking and mapping Israeli artillery strikes in real time, providing civilian early warning. Iranian open-source intelligence channels (FromIran) are publishing delayed but detailed air defense and UAV incident data, indicating a transparent monitoring posture. CENTCOM's public rebuttal of IRGC claims serves to reassure Gulf partners of continued U.S. maritime commitment. Saudi-Iran civilian air links remain operational, suggesting diplomatic channels persist despite tensions. No coordinated multilateral response has been observed across the reported incidents.
sections.intelligence_notes: The concentration of Israeli shelling in Zoutar ash-Sharqiyah, Wadi Zabqin, and the Al-Qantara/Wadi al-Hajir corridor suggests targeting of specific logistics or launch sites rather than broad area suppression. Iranian UAV activity near Sardasht (Iraqi border) and Urmia may indicate surveillance of Kurdish militant positions or cross-border smuggling routes. The Rosatom staffing increase at Bushehr likely involves technical specialists for reactor maintenance or expansion, not necessarily military-related. The Egyptian border crosser's profile and intent remain unverified; IDF's 'grave' assessment may reflect election-period sensitivity. Black Hawk movements toward northern Israel could support routine troop rotation or forward deployment.
